# XRechnung resources bundled by Pitchary

These resources are the unmodified official XRechnung validator configuration release `v2026-08-31` (XRechnung 3.0.2) and KoSIT Validator `1.6.3` standalone JAR. The adjacent `PITCHARY-MANIFEST.json` records source URLs and SHA-256 digests. Original notices in XML/XSD/XSL files, official README/docs and Apache 2.0 licenses are retained.

Source projects:

- https://github.com/itplr-kosit/validator-configuration-xrechnung/tree/v2026-08-31
- https://github.com/itplr-kosit/validator/tree/v1.6.3
- https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/UBL-2.1.zip
- https://github.com/ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931/releases/tag/validation-1.3.16

The JAR contains its upstream dependency notices and licenses. Runtime Java is downloaded only by the desktop build, from the pinned Eclipse Temurin release, and is distributed with that runtime's legal directory. See `docs/INVOICE_EXPORTS.md` for the execution and acceptance contract.
